expfree_upper_bound.meaning: an exp-FREE inner loop times the same as baseline DIRECT: this proxy is memory-bandwidth-bound (~85% of A100 HBM peak) and the per-pixel exp is fully hidden. No exp-elimination technique of any kind can exceed ~1.0x in this proxy; QSCAN's measured 0.98-0.99 is the full cost of its scan/shuffle overhead.

numeric_validation_raw_no_guard.summary: the legal QSCAN chain (allowed exps only, pure-multiply k^j, multiplicative scan) is numerically unusable on real contiguous rows: NaN on 0.02%-6.8% of items, |error| up to 0.88 on finite items, cull-branch flips up to 4.2% of items, all far from the 1/255 threshold
numeric_validation_raw_no_guard.mechanism: leader-anchored chain: when the 16-px row clips the footprint edge, q(xs) and q(xs+15) can differ by thousands; G0=exp(-q(xs)) underflows to 0 while r0=exp(-d0) overflows to inf inside the same subgroup -> 0*inf = NaN; FTZ of intermediate prefixes yields finite-but-wrong values. Repairing this requires the per-lane direct value = exactly the P18-P0 defect mode (per-lane recompute) that invalidated the original run.
numeric_validation_raw_no_guard.guard_note: the original guard (branch mismatch -> fallback) only catches non-finite lanes; the finite-but-wrong lanes pass the guard unless a full per-lane direct recompute (forbidden) is added.
